frame: CAD assembly frame of resources/cad/z001-opus-m-93de7567 (mm): +X robot left, +Y back, +Z up
note: Masses are datasheet/manufacturer values (see electronics_masses.json); positions come from the backpack v4.2 placeholders and the head poses. Printed parts are NOT here - build_model_cad.py derives those from mesh volume x PETG density.

items.name: LiPo 3S 2200 (Gens Ace)
items.source: https://gensace.de/collections/soaring (Soaring 30C ~174 g) / https://genstattu.com/... (Adventure 60C 185 g)
items.note: Gens Ace 3S 2200 mAh XT60. Variant not recorded: 168-185 g across the range (higher C-rate ~ +10 g); 180 g is the middle. The 25 mm deep CAD pocket fits the 23-25 mm (45C/60C) bodies. Heaviest single part - weigh it.

items.name: XY-CD63 cutoff
items.source: relay datasheet https://files.seeedstudio.com/wiki/Grove-SPDT_Relay_30A/res/SLA-05VDC-SL-C_Datasheet.pdf (20 g) + PCB/terminal build-up
items.note: No datasheet for the module. Songle SLA-05VDC-SL-A relay 20 g [V] + FR4 56x62x1.6 mm ~11.5 g + 2 screw terminal blocks ~6 g + display/MCU/passives ~4 g. Distributor weights of 51/71 g look like packaged weights. +-10 g - weigh it.
